description: This file defines the ModelGrid class, which models the <grid> element in the OFBiz widget framework. It extends ModelForm and provides functionality for constructing grid representations from XML elements, including handling inheritance via 'extends' attributes and resource references.

classes.name: ModelGrid
classes.description: Represents a <grid> element in the widget configuration, extending ModelForm, providing construction and inheritance logic.

methods.name: ModelGrid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ModelGrid instance from an XML Element, passing parameters to superclass.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a ModelWidgetVisitor to perform operations on this ModelGrid instance.

methods.name: getParentModel
methods.description: Retrieves the parent grid model if an 'extends' resource or grid is specified, supporting resource-based and document-based inheritance, with fallback to form definitions.
